verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an Export API for event data and lists first-party integrations with warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks) plus reverse-ETL tools (Hightouch, Fivetran, RudderStack) that support syncing events to/from a warehouse, satisfying the 'continuous export' half of the story. However, there's no evidence of an in-product warehouse query feature (e.g., querying warehouse tables directly within Amplitude's UI). Missing for 10: in-product warehouse querying capability, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the export-to-warehouse pipelines actually working reliably.
